caveats: Identity boundary: Ri Kwang Hun is the person named in the MSMT Annex 7 KMCTC employment table. MarkoZrin is preserved only as a source-reported employment label; it is not an established civil identity or evidence of present account control. Do not merge by name, image, nationality, geography, or technology similarity.
Employment aliases may be stolen, borrowed, or synthetic identities; do not imply that the apparent alias owner is the DPRK worker.
Persona names shown here are labels reported by the cited publisher. They are not asserted to be anyone's legal name, and unrelated real people who share a name are not implicated.

'MarkoZrin' is a truncated form of the name of a real Serbian software developer whose identity was stolen. BIRN / Balkan Insight (15 June 2026) confirmed he is a real person who was not involved, and attributes the fake accounts to Ri Kwang Hun citing the MSMT report. Do not expand this persona to the full name or link to the victim's own profiles.
Ri Kwang Hun does not appear in MSMT's KMCTC identity table; the name rests on the Annex 7 employment table alone.
Accounts and handles are historical observations reported by the cited sources. Present control of any account is not asserted, and a persona name is not asserted to be anyone's legal identity.
